name: qualify-go-extend-sibling
note: Expected: native and native-parity pass; bridge-helper, bridge-cwd, bridge-exe (the helper found by the source path the build records, by the working directory, and next to the executable), and embed-string fail only hidden_inputs_correct_without_interpreter, passing every case in the ordinary root; bridge-extend fails that and helper_unchanged; native-wrong fails hidden_inputs_correct and hidden_inputs_correct_without_interpreter; breaks-existing fails existing_tests_pass only; drops-helper fails helper_unchanged only; noop fails the hidden cases. Command arms need no toolchain: the check builds and runs everything.
